findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_plan, check_layout, read_plan · Public sink: create_plan, check_layout, read_plan · Destructive: create_plan, check_layout.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_plan, check_layout, read_plan · Public sink: create_plan, check_layout, read_plan · Destructive: create_plan, check_layout

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
